title: Don't Get Forked
description: The companion Foundry VTT game system for Don't Get Forked, a tabletop roleplaying game by Richard Moore: classic monsters raid a town on festival night for the castle's shopping list. Play the eight Entities on their sheets, roll a trait with the Mask or the Monster while the system applies abilities, Costs and Perks as the book says, and keep Suspicion, the Limit, the Turns and dawn on a shared Raid HUD the Storyteller controls. Chases and the lock-up come next.
